classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that the 6 cm difference represents two ratio parts, recover both dimensions, then connect them to rectangle area.

content.prompt: The ratio of length to width in a rectangle is $5:3$. The length is $6\text{ cm}$ longer than the width. Find the area of the rectangle.

answer.short:
$135\text{ cm}^2$.

The difference of two ratio parts is $6\text{ cm}$, so each part is $3\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
The difference between the length and width is $5-3=2$ parts.
$$\begin{align*}\text{One part}&=6\div2\text{ cm}\\\text{One part}&=3\text{ cm}\\\text{Length}&=5\times3\text{ cm}\\\text{Length}&=15\text{ cm}\\\text{Width}&=3\times3\text{ cm}\\\text{Width}&=9\text{ cm}\\\text{Area}&=15\times9\text{ cm}^2\\\text{Area}&=135\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
